text:
noah t: kicking off quick onboarding for customer Cosmos (invoice-plus LoRA) -> base pegasus-13b. goal: token-stability + hybrid quant sanity (int3 fast path, int4 fallback). running compact quickpack now.

noah t: cmd: `./quick_eval --base pegasus-13b --lora cosmos_invoice_v1.safetensors --quant hybrid:int3,int4 --checks token_stability,invoice_format --out /runs/cosmos_qp_1769999998`

mira sood: include the 'invoice-plus-edgecases.json' set (leading hashes, nested brackets, CUR:, CUR$, negative values, thousands separators). also the customer's protected_tokens.txt contains ['#INV:', 'SKU#', '<INV>'] so lock those.

lemar q: last time this customer we saw '#INV:' aliased -> ['#','INV',':'] and downstream parser failed. recommend pre-merge vocab_lock and conservative prune.

ciara (eval-bot): queued id=cosmos-qp-1769999998 on p-qe-gpu-09. streaming logs -> /runs/cosmos_qp_1769999998/log.txt

noah t: initial quickpass done: 4/10 checks failed. primary failures: atomic '#INV:' split, thousands-sep dropped for large amounts, and stray space before currency symbol. sample: `expected: "#INV:0001" got: "# INV:0001"` and `expected: "2,345.00" got: "2345.0"`.

mira sood: sounds like token aliasing + quant rounding/truncation + postproc glue. what does merge log show?

noah t: merge log excerpt: `WARN token_alias: '#INV:' id 59877 collides -> alias to ['#','INV',':']` Token diff preview: `['#INV:':59877 -> 30111, 'SKU#':61200 -> 61200 (ok), '<INV>':53010 -> 53010 (ok)]`

lemar q: plan: (1) create vocab_lock.json pinning '#INV:'->59877, (2) re-run merge with `--vocab-lock`, (3) quantize with `--rounding bankers --prune conservative`, (4) enable hybrid decode fallback int4 for long contexts in canary. Also add a unit test that asserts no protected token mapped to multi-token sequence post-merge.

noah t: applying lock: vocab_lock.json = {"#INV:":"59877","SKU#":"61200","<INV>":"53010"} re-run cmd: `./quick_eval --base pegasus-13b --lora cosmos_invoice_v1.safetensors --vocab-lock vocab_lock.json --quant hybrid:int3,int4 --quant-opts "--rounding bankers --prune conservative" --out /runs/cosmos_qp_1769999998_rerun`

infra-bot: job queued on p-qe-gpu-12, ETA ~4m.

ciara (eval-bot): re-run complete id=cosmos-qp-1769991020. smoke results: 9/10 pass. '#INV:' preserved ✅, numeric formatting fixed ✅. remaining: small paraphrase regression on long-descriptions (ROUGE-L -0.9). full report: s3://redwood-evals/cosmos/onboard/run-1769991020/report.html and token_diff attached at /runs/cosmos_qp_1769999998_rerun/token_diff.json

mira sood: nice. paraphrase drift likely due to int3 weight noise on long contexts. mitigation options: mixed-KV int8 for canary or force int4 fallback for >1024 tokens. I'd favor mixed-KV canary to measure tradeoff.

lemar q: I'll open PR to add pre-merge token-stability gate and set default prune_mode=conservative for any customer merges. PR will include the unit test and link artifacts.

noah t: I'll notify CS and schedule a dedicated canary next week with mixed-KV int8. also note for docs: update onboarding checklist to require protected_tokens.txt and a vocab_lock step.

ciara (eval-bot): advisory: hybrid int3 path shows ~6% CPU decode increase at >2048 tokens; mixed-KV int8 estimated +7% p95 latency but regains ROUGE in internal small trials.

noah t: thanks team — closing quickpack, saving artifacts, and annotating customer ticket with run id and S3 report. :white_check_mark:

mira sood: great turnaround. will review PR and coordinate canary schedule.
